maya: Follow-up from the streaming chat postmortem. We need owners, target dates, and rollback gates. Focus: reconnect/backoff defaults, server partial short-circuit, telemetry/alerts, repro harness, canary + comms.

trent: I can own reconnect/backoff in SDK + handshake retry policy server-side. Plan: RFC by 2026-03-26, PRs by 2026-04-03, canary 2026-04-09. Default: exp backoff, max_attempts=5, jitter ~15%.

sophia: Observability will add metric stream.partial_rate (per-route/model), handshake latency p50/p95/p99, and alert: partial_rate >0.5% sustained 10m or spike >1%. Dashboard + runbook before canary. Target: 2026-03-28.

li: I'll build a deterministic repro harness that injects truncated chunks and network flaps, add nightly CI job, and attach minimal repro to the ticket. Target: 2026-03-25.

trent: Proposed SDK config snippet for review: {"streaming":{"reconnect":{"enabled":true,"strategy":"exp","initial_ms":100,"max_ms":1600,"max_attempts":5,"jitter_fraction":0.15}}}

ops-bot: Created tickets RW-STREAM-1010 (trent), RW-STREAM-1011 (sophia), RW-STREAM-1012 (li).

maya: Server rule: if a single request shows repeated partial markers above threshold, mark event=partial_shortcircuit, invoke safe-fallback (no progressive retries), and persist KV snapshot in logs for 30s. Product comms draft required pre-canary.

eng-runtime: Heads-up: frequent reconnects can impact continuous batching. Recommend a throttle guard on reconnect attempts; trent to sync with runtime.

sophia: Will tag logs with partial_shortcircuit and add trace span; dashboard will surface request-id drilldowns and KV snapshot links.

maya: Closure criteria: PRs merged, canary stable 48h with partial_rate improved vs baseline, telemetry kept 14d then retrospective and close actions. 15m sync Friday to confirm readiness.

trent: ACK 

sophia: ACK 

li: ACK
